title: First build
detail: Initial vessel development — engine systems fitted and the sensor mounting structures built up.

title: Maritime RobotX, Singapore
detail: The inaugural challenge at Marina Bay. TopCat earned a special mention for its use as a research platform.

title: Port River demonstration
detail: A public demonstration run on the Port River, sharing the water with live commercial shipping traffic.

title: Driverless Cars Conference
detail: Demonstration on the Torrens River alongside the conference programme.

title: Major upgrade
detail: New sensors and onboard computers, and a redesigned superstructure to carry them.

title: Maritime RobotX 2, Hawaii
detail: Team Australis2 competed at Sand Island, O'ahu.

title: Electronics refresh
detail: General improvements to the electronics and a round of maintenance upgrades.

title: Port River testing
detail: Ongoing testing and incremental improvement at a private Port River test site.

title: Beachport survey
detail: A research trip to Beachport surveying beach erosion using depth-sounding equipment.
